cls: Why not resolve the `LayoutObject` here instead? Given that we don't expect anything beyond `LayoutBox` and `LayoutText`, this seems to be counter to that. Handling it here would also cover other…
Duplicate logic suggests that this function should be refactored. It was bad. Now it's worse. Maybe do this: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromium/src/+/7209482
A text node with no element ancestor should never occur. Add a DCHECK instead.
`To<>` will crash if this is some other type, and nulls can't happen here, so having this as a conditional is unnecessary.
It would've been preferable to not format the entire file - it introduces a lot of noise.
I think I'd rather prefer to have a new helper for the serialized offset that does this and then calls the original function.
No idea what it would be, if it's not one of those. SVG? 😊 Seems fine to keep the NOTREACHED(), though.
